name: TEENworks at Goodman Community Center
what_you_do: These are paid teen jobs at the community center, with training. All teens earn ServSafe certification and get event catering training. They can also earn high school credit.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12 (the page says the high school programs serve grades 9-12). Other rules are not stated.
pay_detail: Hourly wage; the rate is not stated.
deadline_text: No dates or enrollment status are posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Not stated on the page. Contact the program: TEENworks Manager Trevor Moores or High School Manager Vernon Hill (608-204-8039), or the center at 608-241-1574, info@goodmancenter.org.
notes: Confirm pay, hours and whether enrollment is open by phone. If you are 14 or 15, Wisconsin generally requires a work permit for paid work (see the Wisconsin rules on this site). Address: 214 Waubesa St, Madison.
